propositions: The cache-ineffective warning fires on zero/zero cache counters without any lower bound on input_tokens, so it cannot distinguish a sub-floor never-cacheable prompt from a cacheable prompt that silently failed to cache.

Below the 4096-token CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS floor, zero/zero counters are expected and unactionable, causing ~20 benign warnings per rebar review-plan run and alarm fatigue on a signal meant to catch silent cost bleed.
The CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS constant is duplicated as a literal across pass1.py and structured_run.py and should have one shared definition to avoid drift.
The zero/zero readings are a direct-Anthropic-path fact rather than a model capability, since Bedrock caching demonstrably works for the same prompts.
The fix gates the warning on input_tokens >= CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS, single-sources the constant in capabilities.py, and preserves detection of genuinely cacheable prompts that fail to cache.
The referenced structured_run.py path exists only on epic 061c feature branches and not on origin/main, so the change must be worked on the owning feature branch.
